verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an official CLI, firectl. It is used for one-command LoRA deployment and for configuring autoscaling through CLI flags, and the docs also mention a Nexus CLI for connecting coding tools to Fireworks models. The evidence shows the CLI only in scattered command snippets, not a full CLI reference, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: CLI installation/authentication docs, a full command reference, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output, agent workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Deploy your LoRA trained model with a single command: firectl deployment create
Configure replica counts, scale-up/down windows, scale-to-zero, and load targets for on-demand Fireworks deployments using firectl flags.
Connect coding tools with Nexus CLI, choose Fireworks models directly or through Nexus Auto
